title: Labyrinth Adapt Pass: Noise-Controlled Decoding & Spatial Identity Hierarchy Doctrine
notes: Trial Count Equalization: Noise-controlled decoding across sequence conditions (AXAB vs. BXBA vs. RXRR) requires strict min-N trial downsampling to prevent class-imbalance artifacts.
Fold-Isolated Preprocessing: Feature z-scoring via StandardScaler must be fit strictly within training folds during stratified K-fold CV to prevent temporal/cross-condition data leakage.

Spatial Encoding Gradient Invariant: Omitted identity (what was omitted) exhibits a top-down spatial gradient (FEF > PFC > TEO > V4 > V3 > V2 > V1), contrasting with sensory onset response which peaks in early visual areas.
